name: CARES-NET-V2
description: A Clinical Decision Support System leveraging Explainable AI (XAI) for cardiovascular disease risk prediction with multi-domain PyTorch architecture, SHAP interpretability, and an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

paragraphs: An explainable, domain-guided deep learning system for coronary artery disease (CAD) risk prediction from structured clinical data.
features: 🧠 Domain-Guided Multi-Expert Architecture — four specialized sub-networks (Demographic, Symptom, Physiological/Labs, ECG/Exercise), each learning a representation from a clinically coherent feature group instead of one…
🎛️ Dynamic Softmax Gating + Cross-Expert Attention — a per-patient gating network weighs each domain expert's contribution, followed by multi-head attention fusion across experts.

🔍 Explainable AI (XAI) with SHAP — every prediction ships with per-feature SHAP attributions and a model-native "expert reliance breakdown," precomputed for instant lookup rather than slow on-demand computation.
📊 Calibrated, Uncertainty-Aware Predictions — Temperature Scaling + Monte Carlo Dropout (50-pass) give a calibrated probability and a 95% confidence interval, not just a raw sigmoid output.

🧪 Rigorous Baseline & Ablation Comparison — Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM baselines, plus a 4-way ablation study (plain MLP → experts-only → +gating → full model), all on…

whatItDoes.text: An explainable, domain-guided deep learning system for coronary artery disease (CAD) risk prediction from structured clinical data.
